## Summary

What does this PR change? One or two sentences.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking, no Standard change)
- [ ] Library improvement (non-breaking, no Standard change)
- [ ] Standard Track Suggestion (changes Touchstone Standard; requires version bump)
- [ ] Library Track Suggestion (changes library behavior conforming to Standard)
- [ ] Process Track Suggestion (changes project processes)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / build / packaging

If this is a Suggestion (Standard / Library / Process Track), see `SUGGESTIONS/PROCESS.md`.

## Standard or library version impact

For Standard Track changes:
- [ ] Major version bump required (breaking change)
- [ ] Minor version bump required (additive)
- [ ] Patch version bump required (editorial)
- [ ] No version bump (Library Track or non-spec change)

## Tests

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] Reference test cases updated (Standard Track only)
- [ ] All existing tests pass locally
- [ ] CI passes

## Documentation

- [ ] Standard updated (if Standard Track)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry added
- [ ] README updated if user-visible behavior changes
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md updated if process changes

## Backwards compatibility

Describe any backwards-compatibility implications. If breaking, describe the migration path.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, discussions, or prior art.
